编辑推荐　月光下的奇迹

不知道大家有没有看过《奇迹》这部韩剧，里面的异卵双胞胎姊妹互换了身体，而让她们的长才都有了发挥的空间，对她们的人生都产生了改变，这次，主题书「月亮升起时」也是这样带点魔幻的故事，在月亮的魔力之下，主题书三本故事中的女主角都跟人交换了身体，进而得到一展长才的机会，同时圆满自己的姻缘。

在香弥的《村花有财气》中，女主角因为撞到脑袋，魂魄离体，附到了一个遭遇船难的皇商庶女身上，不只遇上了同样落难的男主角，展现野外求生的本领，让男主角对她刮目相看，更展现出赚钱的天赋，在皇商家获得一席之地，只是皇商庶女无意中目击了家里的一桩大秘密，为她招来了杀身之祸……这下她死了，回到自己的身体里，该怎么跟男主角相认哩？

而裘梦的《密探有点忙》里，身为密探的女主角跟娇弱的相爷千金交换了身躯，只是两人都各有心上人，这一换身体可全都乱了套，而且还有来自皇亲国戚的威胁，意图把变成相爷千金的女主角抓走，更伪造通敌文书栽赃相爷，如果女主角没有当密探的经验，就要陷入大危机……

春野樱在《镇店女朝奉》中，则是安排女主角从富家千金变成了家道中落古董店的千金，振兴家业，避免自己被嫁给七老八十的老头当小妾换钱是她的第一要务，幸好她有着监定古董的好眼光，获得赏识，成为女朝奉，而东家不只长得俊俏、为人仗义，让女主角深深喜欢上他，但问题来了，东家有婚约，而那个婚约对象还是……身为富家千金的她自己！

三位女主角究竟要怎么做才能顺利圆满自己的爱情？而在换了身躯的期间，男女主角又会擦出什么火花？大家千万别错过「月亮升起时」主题书～

阳光透过窗棂射入书房内，映在负手立于博古架前的男子身上，地上拖曳出一道长长的影子。

男子年约二十二、三岁的模样，一双英气剑眉，虎目湛亮，鼻梁挺直，唇薄而红，相对于那些文弱的白面书生，他身上多了一种飒爽的武者英气。

他身着竹青色的锦袍，玉带束腰，左手拇指上有一枚青色的扳指，表情一派的冷肃，直到房门外传来一道清脆的少女声音，他的神色才有了一点波动。

「少爷，奴婢奉茶来。」

「嗯。」

得到房中人的应许，一名青衣小婢这才端着托盘缓步而入，她走到男子身边，将手中托盘举高，「少爷请用茶。」

男子的目光从青衣小婢步入房开始便一直落在她的身上，乌黑的发丝梳成了普通的双丫髻，只简单以青色丝带紮束，耳上无璫，装扮朴素至极，就如同一个随处可见的平凡丫鬟——

但她其实是他最得力的手下之一。

青衣小婢螓首低垂，手中托盘高举，摆出一副恭敬而又谦卑的姿态，这副模样持续到好一会儿后，男子终于动手接过茶盏。

青衣小婢收了托盘，垂眉敛目退后两步站定。

男子的右手压在杯盖上，仿佛是在沉思，然后才缓缓开口，发出的声音音质清朗而富有磁性，「小悠。」

「婢子在。」

「再帮我最后一次，这次事毕，你就自由了。」

青衣小婢没有说话。

男子微掀起杯盖，吹了吹，然后轻轻呷了一口茶，道：「贪欢楼里还缺一个花魁。」

青衣小婢猛地抬头看过去。

她生了一双弯弯柳眉，一双眸子清澈若水，给人一种善良亲和的感觉。鼻子小巧，唇形一般，她没有倾国倾城的容颜，却有着青春少女的清纯美好。

此时，她明澈若水的眸中流露出的是震惊和不敢置信。

她有一会儿发不出声音，不知道要如何表达自己此时的心境。

花魁？公子竟然让她去当花魁？

在明知她再接一个任务，完成之后就可以从组织里获得自由的当口，公子竟然让她去当花魁？

通常他们这些在「皇棋」里为皇上办事的密探，离开时的最后一件任务都不会很难，也不会让接任务的人为难，可是做为头儿的公子，对于她的安排却全然不是这么一回事。

单论当上花魁这件事，对她而言并不困难。

她从小就开始接受训练，以各种身分潜藏在目标身边，收集情报，这么多年下来，她有时都想不起来自己到底长什么样子。

是的，她现在的模样并不是她自己本来的模样，而只是化妆易容成府里一个普通的婢女，这样出现在公子身边就不会引人注目。

靠着这一手易容的本事，她要凭借倾城容貌当上花魁是易如反掌，可问题是，成为一个青楼女子，她能清白的全身而退吗？

这么多年，她在公子手下办事，以为他们至少也有一份同袍之谊，毕竟他们曾并肩作战……他为何可以这般为难她？

柳悠悠握着托盘的手收紧，表情却慢慢恢复平静，重新垂下了眉眼，轻轻地道：「婢子遵命。」

是了，遵命。

她和他的身分犹如云泥之别，更何况他已经定了亲，她便是有再多的不愿、再多的仰慕又能如何？

是时候了断一切了，完成这次任务，她和他也就再无瓜葛，从此山高水远，天各一方。她会去到一个不会再遇到他的地方重新生活，心底的那一抹情愫，她会从此让它们永不见天日。

真心错付的感觉，她现在知道了。

公子想必是以此来警告她，让她收起自己的痴心妄想吧。

柳悠悠心中苦涩地一笑，她一直知道那只是自己的痴心妄想，她也并不想让公子知道，可是，公子大约还是察觉到了吧，所以才以这样残忍的做法来警告她。

青楼的花魁，周旋于各色男子之间，她甚至不能清清白白地获得自由离去，何其残忍！

梦，该醒了！

柳悠悠将头垂得更低了些，抱着托盘慢慢向屋外退去。

男子一直看着她的身影退出书房，消失在门口。

过了良久，他才狠狠地灌了一口茶。此时，茶已凉，就如同他此刻的心情。

都到了这般地步，她依旧还是这样克制隐忍，永远固守着那一道身分天堑，永远将他隔在另一端，不允许他再接近哪怕一步的距离。

他们曾经同生共死过，她曾经顶着风雪、背着他艰难跋涉百里求生，可是，她却永远不肯将她的那颗心明明白白地捧到他面前，永远藏着掖着。

这该死的身分有别，该死的……

男子狠狠攥紧了茶盏，随着一声清脆的碎裂声，有鲜血自他的左手滴下。

殷红的血滴落在地，刺目而又鲜艳。

第1章(1)

「贪欢楼」，顾名思义，就是男子寻花问柳之所，男欢女爱的极乐之地，夜晚的贪欢楼人声喧闹，车马不绝。

楼前一串红灯笼高高悬挂，映出门前迎客的莺莺燕燕，莺声燕语中红粉罗帕轻抛，不知勾住了多少寻芳客的脚步。

一辆雕花嵌珠的马车在楼前停下，青衣童子跳下车辕伸手掀起了车帘，一道颀长的身影从车厢内矮身钻出，他一身的锦衣绣服，面容俊美，气质英武，正是当朝大将军的三子唐忠信唐小将军。

如今，京城之中，谁人不知，哪个不晓，唐小将军恋上了「贪欢楼」中的花魁娘子花盼云，一个月之中倒有大半个月的时间是泡在花盼云的香闺中，只羡鸳鸯不羡仙。

Editor’s recommendation: Miracle under the Moonlight

I don’t know if you have watched the Korean drama "Miracle". In it, the fraternal twin sisters exchanged bodies, which gave them room to display their talents and changed their lives. This time, the theme book "When the Moon Rises" is also a magical story. Under the magic of the moon, the heroines in the three stories in the theme book all exchanged bodies with others, and then got the opportunity to show off their talents and at the same time consummate their marriages.

In Xiangya's "Village Flower", the heroine hit her head and her soul left her body and possessed the body of a concubine of an imperial merchant who was in a shipwreck. Not only did she meet the male protagonist who was also in trouble, she showed her ability to survive in the wild and made the male protagonist admire her with admiration., she also showed her talent for making money and got a place in the imperial merchants. However, the concubine of the imperial merchants accidentally witnessed a big secret in her family, which led to her death... Now that she is dead and returned to her own body, how should she recognize the male protagonist?

In Qiu Meng's "The Secret Agent is a Little Busy", the heroine who is a secret agent exchanges bodies with the delicate daughter of the prime minister, but both of them have their own sweethearts. This body change is all messed up, and there are also threats from the emperor's relatives, who intend to kidnap the heroine who has become the daughter of the prime minister, and even forge documents of collaboration with the enemy to frame the prime minister. If the heroine does not have the experience of being a spy, she will be in a big crisis...

Haruno Sakura arranged for the heroine to change from the daughter of a wealthy family to the daughter of a middle-aged antique shop in "The Shopkeeper". Her first priority was to revitalize the family business and avoid being married to an old man as a concubine in exchange for money. Fortunately, she has a supervisorThe good taste of antiques was appreciated and he became a female court servant. His boss was not only handsome and righteous, but also made the heroine fall in love with him. But the problem came. His boss had a marriage contract, and the marriage partner was... herself, the daughter of a wealthy family!

What should the three heroines do to successfully consummate their love?And during the period of changing bodies, what kind of sparks will the male and female protagonists create?Don’t miss the “When the Moon Rises” themed book~

Sunlight shines into the study through the window lattice, reflecting on the man standing in front of the book shelf with his hands behind his hands, dragging a long shadow on the ground.

The man is about 22 or 23 years old, with a pair of heroic sword-shaped eyebrows, bright tiger eyes, a straight bridge of nose, and thin and red lips. Compared with those frail white-faced scholars, he has a sassy warrior's heroic spirit.

He was wearing a bamboo-green brocade robe, a jade belt around his waist, and a green thumb on his left thumb. His expression was cold and solemn. It wasn't until a clear girl's voice came from outside the door that his expression changed a little.

"Master, my servant brings tea."

"Yeah."

After receiving the permission of the person in the room, a young maid in green slowly walked in with a tray. She walked to the man's side, raised the tray in her hand and said, "Master, please have some tea."

The man's eyes have been falling on the young maid in green since she entered the room. Her black hair was combed into an ordinary double bun, simply tied with a green ribbon. There were no earrings on her ears. Her dress was extremely simple, just like an ordinary maid that could be seen everywhere——

But she is actually one of his most effective subordinates.

The young maid in Tsing Yi lowered her head and held the tray high in her hand, assuming a respectful and humble posture. This attitude lasted for a while before the man finally took the tea cup.

The young maid in green clothes put away the tray, lowered her eyebrows and lowered her eyes, took two steps back and stood still.

The man's right hand pressed on the cup lid, as if he was meditating, and then he slowly spoke, with a clear and magnetic voice, "Xiaoyou."

"The maid is here."

"Help me one last time. Once this is over, you will be free."

The young maid in green didn't speak.

The man slightly lifted the lid of the cup, blew on it, then took a sip of tea and said, "The Tanhuan Tower is still short of an oiran."

The young maid in green clothes suddenly raised her head and looked over.

She has a pair of curved eyebrows and a pair of eyes as clear as water, giving people a kind and friendly feeling.She has a small nose and average-shaped lips. She does not have a charming face, but she has the innocence and beauty of a young girl.

At this time, her clear eyes showed shock and disbelief.

She was speechless for a moment, not knowing how to express her state of mind at this time.

Oiran?The young master actually asked her to be an oiran?

Knowing that she would take on another task and that she would be free from the organization after completing it, the young master actually asked her to become an oiran?

Normally, the secret agents who work for the emperor in "Imperial Chess" would not have a difficult last task when they leave, nor would they make it difficult for the person taking the task. However, as the leader, the young master's arrangements for her were completely different.

Just talking about becoming an oiran, it is not difficult for her.

She has been training since she was a child, lurking around targets in various identities and collecting intelligence. After so many years, she sometimes can't even remember what she looks like.

Yes, her current appearance is not her original appearance, but just put on makeup to disguise herself as an ordinary maid in the mansion, so that she will not attract attention when she appears next to the young master.

With her ability to disguise herself, it would be easy for her to become a courtesan with her stunning appearance. But the question is, as a brothel girl, can she escape innocently?

For so many years, she had worked under the young master, thinking that they at least had a comradeship. After all, they had fought side by side... Why could he embarrass her like this?

Liu Youyou tightened her grip on the tray, but her expression slowly returned to calm. She lowered her eyebrows again and said softly, "My maid, I obey."

Yes, obey.

She and him were as different as each other, not to mention that he was already engaged, so what would happen if she had more reluctance and admiration?

It was time to end everything. After completing this mission, she and he would no longer have anything to do with each other. From now on, they would be separated by mountains and rivers.She would go to a place where she would never meet him again, and the feelings in her heart would never see the light of day.

She now knew the feeling of truly being wronged.

The young master must have used this as a warning to her to stop her wishful thinking.

Liu Youyou smiled bitterly in her heart. She always knew that it was just her wishful thinking, and she didn't want the young master to know. However, the young master probably noticed it, so he warned her in such a cruel way.

The courtesan of a brothel deals with all kinds of men. She can't even leave innocently. How cruel!

Dream, it’s time to wake up!

Liu Youyou lowered her head, holding the tray and slowly retreating out of the house.

The man kept watching her figure exit the study and disappear through the door.

After a long time, he took a deep sip of tea.At this time, the tea was cold, just like his mood at the moment.

Even after reaching this point, she was still so restrained and forbearing, always clinging to that barrier of identity, forever separating him from the other end, not allowing him to get even one step closer.

They had lived together and died together. She had braved the wind and snow and carried him on her back to trek hundreds of miles to survive. However, she would never openly hold her heart in front of him and hide it forever.

This damn identity is different, damn...

The man clenched the teacup tightly, and with a crisp cracking sound, blood dripped from his left hand.

Drops of bright red blood fell to the ground, dazzling and bright.

Chapter 1(1)

"Tanhuan Tower", as the name suggests, is a place where men go to find flowers and willows, a place of bliss for men and women to make love. At night, Tanhuan Tower is noisy with people and cars and horses.

A string of red lanterns hangs high in front of the building, reflecting the warblers and swallows greeting guests in front of the door. The soft tosses of red pink rhopada in the sounds of warblers and swallows have caught the footsteps of many pilgrims.

A carriage with carved patterns and inlays with beads stopped in front of the building. A boy in green jumped out of the carriage and reached out to lift the curtain. A tall figure emerged from the carriage. He was dressed in brocade and embroidered clothes, with a handsome face and a heroic temperament. He was none other than General Tang Zhongxin, the third son of the current general.

Nowadays, no one in the capital knows that General Tang has fallen in love with Hua Panyun, the courtesan in the "Tanhuan Tower". He spends more than half of a month in Hua Panyun's fragrant boudoir, only enviing the mandarin ducks but not the immortals.
